recipe.source: M1 section 3.4 gives seconds, fps and leaf_cover; the rest are chosen in serpentguard.video
recipe.scene: the raw photo, without the exposure fix; the live step fixes each frame
recipe.easing: cosine between keypoints: the camera slows into each pose
recipe.border: reflect_101: where pan or rotation reaches past the photo's edge, even at zoom 1, the photo is mirrored into view
recipe.shake_model: AR(1) on x, y and rotation, unit variance, scaled by the clip's shake
recipe.blur: a line kernel along the frame centre's image motion since the last frame, times the exposure
recipe.noise: gaussian per pixel and channel, sigma / sqrt(light gain)
recipe.occluder: the front end's predicted mask, never SAM (R79); without a usable one, seeded spots in a central ellipse
recipe.order: leaves on the scene, camera warp, motion blur, low light, noise, JPEG

methods.per_frame: each frame's own verdict and top-1
methods.ema: EMA (alpha 0.3) of every head's probabilities and the embedding, then decide
methods.vote_4_of_6: a label shows while it fills 4 of the last 6 per-frame labels; otherwise 'unknown' (species -1), never a stale label (R87)

stability: a label is stable once it stays 1.0 s; time_to_stable is when the first stable label shows, time_to_confirmed when it has stayed 1.0 s, clip_correct whether the last stable label is right

front_end.no_snake: a frame whose best D1 box is under the decision file's tau_snake, or that has none, has no snake: SnakeID does not run, the per-frame and EMA methods show 'unknown' and no species there, voting counts it as 'unknown', and the EMA runs over the frames that found a snake, as pipeline._run_clip does (R111)

decision.expected_verdict: dangerous for a danger-table species, not_listed otherwise; unknown is never right

clean_control: clean_* columns: the model on the undistorted photo, through the same live step
